materials.paper: cream face / ochre edge / 3-5 unit offset
materials.wood: colored front / cream highlight opacity .2-.4 / forest side opacity .2-.24 / sparse grain
materials.terrain: two or three flat muted layers, no gradients
materials.shadow: small flat ellipse, opacity at most .18

owner_variant: --owner CSS custom property on inline SVG; fallback red. Fixed semantic colors must not be recolored as ownership.
rotation: scene transform around 60,60; orientation is independent of owner and quantity
quantity: runtime overlay only; null renders ?. Illustrative stack layers and icon counts are not observed quantities.
identification: shape plus motif, not color alone; 24px is silhouette preview and does not guarantee subtype identification
unclear: generic dashed unknown face with question mark; keep source confidence and gap, never invent hidden/front-face information
art_scope: original representative vector presets from research component classes; not commercial artwork, exhaustive printed component inventory, legal placement map, or recognition model
